subject: Developer Lift Summit — co-hosted 'Embeddings in Product' track?
content:
From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@developerlift.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Aug 16, 2026 at 9:14 AM PDT
Subject: Proposal: co-hosted 'Embeddings in Product' track at Developer Lift Summit

Hi Irene,

Hope you're well — I run Partnerships at Developer Lift and we recently reviewed Redwood's runtime work. We're launching our mid-October Developer Lift Summit (virtual + small in-person hubs) and would love to propose a co-hosted track titled 'Embeddings in Product: engineering patterns and real deployments.'

High-level ask: Redwood as a co-host + two speaking slots (one product/eng talk, one customer panel), a 6x9 booth at our San Francisco hub, and a joint pre-summit 30-minute developer webinar the week prior. We can amplify via our newsletter (50k dev subscribers) and provide speaker coaching.

Attached one-pager: devlift-copartner-onepager.pdf (audience breakdown & sponsorship tiers).

Would Redwood be interested? If so, can you loop in your partnerships/field folks so we can align on dates/asks?

Thanks,
Sofia Ramirez
Head of Partnerships, Developer Lift
sofia@developerlift.ai

-----Original Message-----
[No prior messages]

---
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@developerlift.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Aug 16, 2026 at 11:05 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Proposal: co-hosted 'Embeddings in Product' track at Developer Lift Summit

Sofia — thanks for the note and the one-pager. This sounds aligned with where our product marketing and field teams want to push later this year. A few quick questions so we can scope internally:

- Target audience: are you focused on platform engineers, ML engineers, or product managers?
- Registrant expectations: what are typical live attendance vs. registered numbers for the webinar and summit?
- Booth logistics: is the 6x9 paid or part of a sponsorship package (we usually decide sponsorship level by mid-month).
- Customer panel: do you have a candidate panelist (we can also propose one of our existing early customers).

Looping in Marissa (partnerships) and Karthik (field/dev relations) to coordinate materials and the engineering deep dive. Ben — can you weigh in on whether we want to route a pre-summit demo for select customers?

Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Alliances & Partner Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-partner-teams.pdf

From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@developerlift.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom@cloudanchor.co>
Date: Tue, Aug 17, 2026 at 8:22 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Proposal: co-hosted 'Embeddings in Product' track at Developer Lift Summit

Thanks for the quick reply, Irene. Answers below + attaching the draft agenda and sponsor package (devlift-agenda-v1.docx).

- Audience: primarily platform engineers and infra-focused ML engineers; product/PM attendance is typically ~15% of registrants.
- Typical numbers: webinar preregistration 1.5k–3k, live attendance ~20–30% of registrants; Summit total registered ~8–12k across all tracks, live hub attendance SF ~400–600.
- Booth: 6x9 is part of our Bronze sponsorship (USD 6k) which includes a single booth staff pass and a paragraph in the Summit sponsor page. We can offer a promotional discount for co-hosts.
- Customer panel: we had thought of inviting CloudAnchor (Tom Blake) as an example customer using embeddings for search relevance; cc'ing Tom to introduce.

Proposed assets: short co-branded landing page, joint blog post announcing the track, and a 30-min pre-summit webinar. If Redwood can commit by Aug 20 we can reserve the SF hub booth at the discounted rate.

Best,
Sofia

Attachments: devlift-agenda-v1.docx

On Tue, Aug 17, 2026 at 8:22 AM PDT, Tom Blake <tom@cloudanchor.co> wrote:
> Happy to be considered for the panel — we can make a short case study around search-quality improvements from embeddings.
> 
> Tom Blake
> Head of Product, CloudAnchor

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Aug 18, 2026 at 2:30 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Developer Lift Summit — co-hosted 'Embeddings in Product' track?

Quick internal thoughts — copying content/field below.

1) Go/no-go criteria (marketing + field):
   - Target audience match (platform/ML infra) — yes per Sofia.
   - Lead volume makes sense for a Bronze sponsorship and single session — yes.
   - Customer availability for panel (CloudAnchor onboard) — yes.

2) Recommended Redwood package:
   - Confirm Bronze booth (take the discounted co-host rate)
   - 45-minute deep-dive session (30 min talk + 15 min customer panel + 5–10 min live Q&A)
   - Pre-summit 45-min hands-on demo webinar for developers (recording gated behind simple form)
   - Co-branded blog swap: Redwood writes technical how-to; Developer Lift writes promotional piece and cross-posts.

3) Ops asks / deliverables & owners:
   - Marketing: co-branded landing page + blog swap (Marissa lead)
   - Field/Tech enablement: hands-on demo + short sample repo (Karthik lead)
   - Sales/Tracking: HubSpot capture + UTM (Ben lead)

4) Timeline: need a firm commit by Fri Aug 20 to secure SF hub booth discount; assets due Sep 20 for copy/design; final speaker slate by Oct 1.

Ben — can you create the HubSpot tracking form and share link? Karthik — estimate engineering time (demo repo + 20-min recording). If all clear I'll confirm to Sofia.

Marissa
VP, Partnerships & Growth
Redwood Inference

Sofia / team — thanks for the answers and for the quick turnaround. Redwood is in: we will commit to the Bronze sponsorship (please send invoice to finance@redwoodinference.com with the co-host discount applied), confirm a 45-minute co-hosted session (30-min product + 15-min panel / Q&A), and we'll do the co-branded blog swap and a pre-summit 45-min hands-on demo webinar.

Next steps / owners:
- Legal & procurement: Marissa to get MOU/terms to your team by Aug 23; please include sample sponsor terms if you have them.
- Marketing: Marissa to coordinate landing page + blog draft; Ben will provide HubSpot embed + UTM.
- Field engineering: Karthik to scope demo repo + recording (estimate 12–18 engineer hours + 4 hours recording/edit).
- Customer panel: Tom Blake (CloudAnchor) confirmed; Sofia please send proposed questions and logistics.

Attachments: redwood-sponsorship-commitment.pdf

If you can send a DocuSign or MOU by Monday (Aug 23) we'll route for sign-off and payment. Looking forward to partnering.

Irene Choi
Director, Alliances & Partner Programs
Redwood Inference
